The refutation goes through with the same proof term. I checked every instance the counterexample needs by inferInstance: ConnectedSpace XS, LocPathConnectedSpace XS, SecondCountableTopology XA and VV, ConnectedSpace VV. XS and XA are subtypes of C^2 / R x R x C with the subspace topology. DIRECTION OF STRENGTH (refutation): each Lean hypothesis is at least the paper's. The family analytic, the models locally Galoisian (literal DEC-55 IsSLSCInCC over every open, strict GX), and HasAutContinuousTamifying (DEC-87 (b)) are the marked or ruled notions. So not_localVirtTameStatement really refutes l.1974 under the ruled readings, and also under the printed reading of X_A-manifold.
